summary: Sparta fire tower in Winn Parish's Kisatchie National Forest; a March 1944 report named its lookout. Marked removed; no site description found.

facts.status_note: Marked removed by the lookouts site; no source describes the site today.

events.note: Beatrice Collins, 17, appointed Lookout A for the Sparta tower, as reported March 30, 1944

evidence.supports: Kisatchie NF; five miles northwest of Calvin
evidence.quote: for the Sparta fire tower in the Kisatchie National Forest five miles northwest of Calvin

evidence.supports: Beatrice Collins, 17, of Calvin, appointed Lookout A
evidence.quote: Miss Beatrice Collins, the 17-year-old daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Willie Collins of Calvin has been appointed 'Lookout A' for the Sparta fire tower

evidence.supports: report calls her first woman or girl in Louisiana appointed
evidence.quote: She is the first woman or girl in Louisiana to receive such an appointment from the Federal government.

evidence.supports: father lookout for several years, then promoted to agriculture aid
evidence.quote: Her father for several years was lookout on the Sparta tower, but recently was promoted agriculture aid by the U.S. Forestry Service.

evidence.supports: duties: climb to crow's nest 100 feet up, alert for forest fires
evidence.quote: The lookout in a fire tower must climb to the crowsnest, 100 feet above the ground and while on duty must be on the alert for forest fires

evidence.supports: newspaper credited as The Town Talk
Sparta listed in Winn Parish, Kisatchie National Forest
evidence.quote: SPARTA Winn Parish - Kisatchie National Forest

corrections.why: Spelling. The Sparta page header has the typo; its quoted 1944 report and the Louisiana index spell the forest Kisatchie.

notes_for_editor: The 1944 report is known only as quoted on the Central US Lookouts page, which credits The Town Talk; the original newspaper was not found in two searches. Removal date and what stands at the site are unknown. The record's agency has a typo, offered as a correction. The record's coordinates were not checked against the township and section, which the page gives without a precise point. No photos found.
